scope: Repository-wide source/documentation audit, incremental build of every local library module, complete-library transitive axiom inspection, selected historical evidence integrity and numerical-summary checks. No physical TOE/Clay certificate or complete simulation replication is claimed.
backup: Full pre-cleanup worktree, hashes, Git status and binary diff stored outside the repository at unifiedtheory-audit-backups/20261109-084726.

build.mode: Incremental Lake verification; unchanged dependency-checked artifacts may be replayed.

checkpoint_integrity.interpretation: Historical scoped checkpoint, not a fresh certificate for this checkout. Existing source differences were preserved; a separate build and axiom inspection checks the present library.

numerical_summary_recheck.scope: Recompute ratios and reported tests from stored observations; no Monte Carlo rerun. Independent-error delta propagation.

criteria.test16: For each C >= 6, R(C) - 2*sigma <= 2.6. The separate C=4 assertion exceeds 2.6 on central values only; its significance is weak.
criteria.test17: For C=8,12, central ratios in [1.6, 2.4]. Three of four fail the stated window.

credential_pattern_scan.scope: Limited plaintext credential-pattern scan; no values recorded and not a comprehensive security audit.

limitations: Docker image was not built; Docker is unavailable in this environment.
Hardware/GPU experiments and all historical numerical studies were not rerun.
Historical overlay verifiers are not claimed to pass against this changed checkout.
Substantial pre-existing uncommitted research remains local. No commit or push was performed.
GitHub Actions workflow syntax was checked locally; the workflow was not run remotely.

all_library_axioms.scope: All declarations whose defining module is in the local UnifiedTheory library, including private declarations. Native computation dependencies are permitted and disclosed.

thermal_summary_recheck.scope: Recomputed registered thresholds from newly available stored observations; no simulation rerun. Error differences assume independent estimates.

concurrent_gauge_record_integrity.scope: Integrity of the concurrent targeted gauge verification record; its numerical checks were not rerun by the repository audit.

concurrent_worktree_updates_preserved.interpretation: External research updates preserved and incorporated into current status. These are not audit-authored experiment results.

source_repairs.changes: Missing finite-cardinality import and invalid standalone docstring fixed; comments narrowed to actual homogeneity/distinctness/cardinality results.
Missing logarithm import, noncomputability, and nonempty finite-index instance fixed; unsupported Wick-rotation and interference claims removed.
